title: Privacy Policy
blocks:
**Markham Community Connect (MCC)**  
**Effective Date: October 12, 2026**  
**Contact-processing information updated: October 17, 2026**
Markham Community Connect (MCC) respects the privacy of community members, participants, volunteers and families who engage with our organization.
### 1. Information We Collect
Depending on the program or service, MCC may collect:

- Participant names and contact information
- Parent or guardian contact details
- Program registration and participation information
- Volunteer information
- Participant age groups
- Information required for event coordination and safety
- Payment or donation records where applicable
MCC collects information reasonably necessary to organize, administer and improve its programs and activities.
### 2. How We Use Information
Information collected may be used to:

- Manage program registrations and participation
- Respond to inquiries
- Communicate program schedules, changes and announcements
- Coordinate volunteers and community events
- Maintain attendance and financial records
- Meet applicable grant reporting and organizational requirements
- Improve community programs and services
MCC does not sell personal information to third parties.
### 3. Photography & Video Policy
Markham Community Connect (MCC) may take photographs and record videos during its programs, activities and community events.
These materials may be used by MCC for promotional, educational, reporting and community engagement purposes, including on our website, social media, printed materials and other communications.
Photographs and videos created by MCC or on its behalf are considered MCC materials, subject to applicable rights and permissions.

Participants, parents or guardians who do not wish to be photographed or recorded, or who have concerns about the use of their images, should inform MCC through our Contact page, preferably before the event.
MCC will make reasonable efforts to respect these requests and address concerns about published materials.

**For children's programs, retain appropriate parent or guardian photo permissions as part of the registration process where required. A general website opt-out notice does not replace consent required by applicable law.**
### 4. Children and Youth
MCC offers activities for children and young people.
Parents or legal guardians may be required to provide registration information, emergency contacts and permissions before a child participates.
MCC takes reasonable steps to protect information relating to minors.
### 5. Contact Form and Third-Party Services

When you use our contact form, we collect your name, email address, optional phone number, subject, message and any selected program so MCC can respond to your enquiry. Contacting MCC does not guarantee program registration.

Cloudflare hosts the website and contact service and provides Turnstile security checks. Resend processes and delivers contact enquiries to MCC's Microsoft 365 mailbox at info@markhamcc.ca. These providers process information in connection with delivering and securing their services under their applicable policies.

The website does not maintain a submission database. Enquiry records may remain with our email providers and in MCC's mailbox under applicable provider policies and MCC's retention practices described below. Please do not include sensitive health, financial or participant information in the contact form.
MCC may use third-party platforms, including Microsoft Forms, Zeffy and other approved registration or payment providers.
Information submitted through these services may also be subject to their respective privacy policies and security practices.
MCC does not store payment-card information directly through its static website.
### 6. Information Protection
MCC takes reasonable measures to protect information against unauthorized access, misuse or disclosure.
Access to participant information is limited to individuals who reasonably need it for legitimate organizational purposes.
### 7. Information Retention
MCC retains personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for program administration, recordkeeping, grant compliance or legal requirements.
Individuals may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal information, subject to applicable requirements.
### 8. Website Cookies and Analytics
MCC may use essential website technologies necessary for website operation and security.
The current MCC website does not use tracking cookies, analytics or advertising technologies.
### 9. External Websites
Our website may contain links to external websites or services.
MCC is not responsible for the privacy practices of independent third-party websites.
### 10. Privacy Questions
Individuals with privacy questions, photograph concerns or information requests may contact MCC using the website Contact page.
### 11. Policy Updates
MCC may update this Privacy Policy as its programs, practices and legal obligations evolve.

title: Terms & Conditions
blocks:
**Markham Community Connect (MCC)**  
**Effective Date: October 12, 2026**
### 1. About MCC
Markham Community Connect (MCC) is a nonprofit community organization offering programs, activities and events for children, youth, adults, seniors and families.
### 2. Website Information
Information provided on this website is intended for general community information.
Program dates, times, availability, fees, venues and other details may change.
MCC will make reasonable efforts to communicate significant program changes.
### 3. Program Registration
Submitting an inquiry or contacting MCC does not guarantee registration.
Participation is subject to program availability, eligibility, applicable payment requirements and confirmation from MCC or its designated registration provider.
### 4. Registration Fees and Refunds
**MCC General Refund Policy**
Registration fees are non-refundable once payment is made.
Participants should confirm the schedule, location and program format before registering.
Refunds will be issued if MCC cancels the program. Otherwise, registration fees are non-refundable, except where applicable law requires otherwise or MCC has expressly approved an exception.
### 5. Children and Youth
Parents or legal guardians are responsible for providing accurate registration information, necessary permissions and emergency contact details where required.
Children must follow applicable program and venue rules.
### 6. Participant Conduct
All participants, volunteers and visitors are expected to treat others respectfully and follow reasonable safety instructions.
MCC may restrict participation where serious misconduct or safety concerns arise, subject to applicable requirements.
### 7. Health and Safety
MCC aims to provide safe and inclusive community programming.
Participants and families should consider whether an activity is suitable for their individual circumstances and inform MCC of any relevant accommodation or safety needs.
MCC cannot eliminate all risks associated with physical or community activities.
### 8. Photography and Video
MCC may photograph or record community programs and events for documentation, communication and promotional purposes.
Please refer to MCC's Privacy Policy for further information, including how participants and parents or guardians can communicate photography preferences.
### 9. Donations
Donations support MCC community programs and activities.
MCC will not represent donations as eligible for charitable tax receipts unless legally authorized to issue them.
### 10. Third-Party Services
Some registrations, donations and payments may be processed through third-party services.
These services may have their own terms and privacy policies.
### 11. Website Content
Website materials produced by MCC, including text, designs, photographs and graphics, may not be reproduced for unauthorized commercial purposes, subject to applicable rights.
### 12. Changes to Programs and Terms
MCC may update its programs, website information and these Terms & Conditions.
### 13. Contact
Questions regarding these terms may be submitted through MCC's Contact page.

title: Accessibility Statement
blocks:
**Markham Community Connect (MCC)**  
**Effective Date: October 12, 2026**
### Our Commitment
Markham Community Connect is committed to creating welcoming, respectful and inclusive opportunities for individuals and families of different ages, abilities and backgrounds.
We aim to reduce barriers to participation in our website, programs and community events.
### Website Accessibility
MCC strives to make its website accessible and easy to use.
Our accessibility efforts include:

- Clear and readable website content
- Mobile-friendly layouts
- Keyboard-accessible navigation
- Descriptive links and headings
- Appropriate alternative text for meaningful images
- Consistent navigation structures
- Readable text and colour contrast
We use recognized web accessibility guidelines, including WCAG, to guide ongoing improvements.
### Accessible Community Programming
MCC aims to provide inclusive community programs.
Accessibility features may vary depending on the venue, program and available resources.
Participants requiring accommodation are encouraged to contact MCC before an event so available options can be discussed.
### Alternative Formats
Individuals who experience difficulty accessing information on our website may contact MCC to request assistance or an alternative accessible format.
### Accessibility Feedback
We welcome feedback regarding website or program accessibility.
Please contact MCC through our website Contact page.
MCC will make reasonable efforts to respond to accessibility concerns.
### Continuous Improvement
Accessibility is an ongoing commitment.
MCC will continue reviewing its website, activities and communications to identify and reduce barriers wherever reasonably possible.
